name: Put' mertveca
source: When an average slacker guy manages to invite a hot redhead Susane on a date, he thinks that his life might finally be turning a new leaf. Instead he ends up drained of his blood, rises as a vampire and gets involved in a hunt for a long forgotten vampire artifact.
translation: 一个普普通通、整天偷懒的男人终于约到了性感的红发女孩Susane。他以为人生终于要迎来转机，没想到却被吸干血液，变成了吸血鬼，还被卷入一场追寻早已被遗忘的吸血鬼遗物的行动。
